summary:
The 模型接口, 角色与称呼 and 提示词模板 pages are built to the "Danmaku native" design with the teal/coral colours. I used only the Foundation components and the controller, and did not change any shared component, the shell or tokens.

**pages/ModelPage.tsx + styles/model.css** (split layout)
- **连接**: 接口地址 (mono, link icon, hint "Base URL", help "通常以 /v1 结尾") and API Key (password with key icon and 显示/隐藏 API Key toggle; hint 本地服务通常可留空; help says it is sent as a Bearer token and stays on this machine).
- **模型与参数**:
  - 模型 select shows options as 「id · name · state · 视觉」, the same label as before.
  - The refresh icon button spins while loading; the old code saves first and the help line says so.
  - State/视觉 chips sit on the label row. The note under the select reads 「从接口读到 N 个模型」, and a list failure shows in red with 「可以直接输入模型 ID」.
  - When the list is empty or failed, a free-text mono input replaces the select, as before.
  - 温度: slider 0–2 plus a number box. Both dim, and a help line explains why, when 发送温度参数 is off. That switch sits under the slider, as in the design.
  - 最大输出: tokens, LIMITS.maxTokens.
  - 超时: shown in 秒 and stored in ms (NumberField scale 0.001, integer, clamped to LIMITS.timeoutMs, so it shows 5–1800 秒).
- **视觉输入**: 发送截图 switch, plus a 截图设置 → link to #capture.
- **Aside 连接测试**:
  - Full-width button: spinner and 「测试中…」 while testing, disabled while any working action runs.
  - Result is a dismissible ok/bad callout (role=status) with a Chinese headline, the message and the endpoint in mono.
  - Note (matches the old code: save → GET /models → refresh the list): 「测试前会先保存当前修改，再请求接口的 /models；完成后刷新模型列表。」
  - Tip about 生成一次. It says the draft is saved first, changes wording when vision is off, and links to the logs.

**pages/CharacterPage.tsx + styles/character.css**
- Persona card: coral avatar with the first letter of the name (dark text, 7.1:1), name and persona snippet truncated with an ellipsis, and a language chip. An empty name shows 「未命名角色」 and 「?」.
- **角色**: 角色名, 语言 (datalist zh-CN/zh-TW/ja/en), 人设 textarea, 语气.
- **你**: 用户称呼, 用户身份.
- Every field has a visible help line naming the placeholder it fills.
- **Aside 系统提示词预览**:
  - Values from the settings are highlighted in teal; an empty value shows as an outlined 「空」.
  - jsonShape (with its real JSON) and activeApp (unknown) appear as grey tokens; unknown placeholders are struck through, because they are sent as typed.
  - When 上下文摘要 is on and actually used, the real summary header and a violet token are appended.
  - The pre is a focusable, labelled scroll region.
  - Note that edits to these values cost the prompt cache on the next round, plus 编辑模板 →.

**pages/PromptPage.tsx + styles/prompt.css**
- Card with WAI-ARIA tabs 系统提示词 / 用户提示词 / 摘要提示词. A tab shows a 「空」 chip when its template is empty. `#prompt/summary` or `#prompt/user` opens that tab.
- Each tab has a visible description (cache note; 「留空时只发送截图」, with the text-only fallback mentioned when vision is off; summary usage with {{summaryMaxChars}}).
- 摘要 tab status callout: violet when on, info when off, warn when it is on but never requested (历史轮数 0 or 逐轮滑动), each with a 截图与历史 → link.
- System tab: a warn callout appears when the template lacks requestedCount. Saving then appends the line, mirroring the main process's normalizeConfig.
- Mono editor sized to the window (smaller when a callout is shown) with a focus ring.
- Footer: 「N 字 · M 行」 (countText), a new 恢复默认 button, and 查看填充后的效果 → (system tab).
- **Aside 插入占位符**:
  - One button per placeholder: code, meaning and current value; the + icon appears on hover/focus.
  - {{activeApp}} has a dashed border, struck-through code and the 未实现 TodoTag.
  - {{summaryMaxChars}} appears only on the 摘要 tab.
  - Insertion goes in at the caret of the active tab's textarea. The caret is remembered per tab; a tab never focused gets the text at the end.
  - Insertion uses execCommand("insertText"), so it fires a normal input event and Ctrl+Z works (verified). It falls back to a manual splice that restores the caret. Focus returns to the editor.

**settings/promptPreview.ts (new) + test/promptPreview.test.ts (new)**
- The preview reuses the main process's own `renderTemplate`, `templateValues`, `JSON_SHAPE` and `CONTEXT_SUMMARY_HEADER`, imported from src/electron/main/providers/messageBuilder.ts. That file and modelSettings.ts are pure, with no Electron/Node imports.
- `templateSegments()` splits a template into text, value, fixed and unknown segments; the substitution of each token is still done by renderTemplate.
- Also: previewValues / summaryPreviewValues, mentionsRequestedCount, and summaryInactiveReason.
- 7 tests, including one showing that the joined segments equal renderPrompts().systemText exactly.
checks:
- npm run typecheck: passes (renderer, electron and tests).
- npx vitest run: Test Files 29 passed (29), Tests 396 passed (396). This includes the new test/promptPreview.test.ts with 7 tests.
- npm run build: passes ("✓ 1640 modules transformed … ✓ built in 2.24s").
- Overflow check (Playwright script) on #model, #character and #prompt at 1120x760 and 940x660 with ?demo=error: no horizontal scroll on the page or .page-body. The only elements reported were <b> values inside ellipsis-clipped placeholder rows, which are visually clipped.
- Placeholder insertion tested in the browser: the text lands at the caret, focus returns to the editor, Ctrl+Z undoes it.
- Screenshots were reviewed in both themes and in these states: running, idle, delay, error banner, connection test success and failure, model list failure, temperature off, model not in the list (cloud profile), empty name, unknown placeholder, sliding mode, template without requestedCount.
- The dev server on port 5183 is stopped.
openIssues:
- **Cross-boundary import:** src/renderer/settings/promptPreview.ts imports from src/electron/main/providers/messageBuilder.ts, as the task allowed. That file and its dependency modelSettings.ts are pure, so typecheck and build pass and they add only a few kB to the renderer bundle. Cleaner later: move renderTemplate, templateValues, JSON_SHAPE and CONTEXT_SUMMARY_HEADER into src/shared/ (messageBuilder.ts is not my file).
- **Intentional behaviour differences from the old UI:**
  - If the configured model id is not in a non-empty list, the select now shows it as 「<id> · 不在列表中」 and keeps it selected. The old UI showed the 「从 N 个模型中选择…」 placeholder and hid the configured value. The placeholder now appears only when the model id is empty. As before, you cannot type a custom id while the list has entries.
  - The connection-test success text is rendered in Chinese (「模型列表返回 N 个模型」 / 「接口可以访问，但没有返回模型」) instead of main's English "Connected. N model(s) found.". Failures still show the raw message, and the endpoint is always shown.
- **Additions not in the mockup:**
  - 恢复默认 button in the prompt editor footer; it only changes the draft, so 还原 undoes it.
  - Warn callout when the system template lacks requestedCount (saving appends the line).
  - Warn callout when 上下文摘要 is on but never requested (historyRounds 0 or 逐轮滑动); the character preview's summary line follows the same rule.
  - The 用户提示词 description mentions the English fallback text sent when vision is off.
- **Deep link for the Capture page agent:** `#prompt/summary` (or `#prompt/user`) opens that tab of the prompt page; pageFromHash already ignores the suffix. Set window.location.hash = "prompt/summary", because navigate("prompt") cannot carry the tab.
- **Small deviations from the design:**
  - Tile icon tones: 连接 accent, 模型与参数 coral, 视觉输入 accent, 连接测试 ok, 角色 coral, 你 accent, 系统提示词预览 accent, 插入占位符 accent. I avoided violet so it stays reserved for the summary.
  - Card sub-lines (「角色如何称呼和理解你」, 「点击插入到光标处」) sit under the title, because that is how Card renders sub; the mockup had them inline.
  - The editor and the preview size themselves from 100vh. With the error banner shown at 940x660, the prompt page scrolls a little to reach the editor footer.
- **No shared component, the shell or tokens were modified.**
